correctness.rationale: Three exhaustive nearest-neighbor regions yield 1-P+r P' >= 0 for all p in [0,3]. Reverse triangle Lipschitz interpolation of arbitrary deviations integrates the inequality without assuming geodesics. A line derivative 2(3-p)/9 certifies a profitable nearby deviation for every p>3. The welfare ratio follows from the closest pair and is maximized at the unique root t^3+6t=4. Exact checker: 62500 metric comparisons, rational p=4 gain and root bracket; finite verification is ancillary.

value.rationale: A complete, sharp strategyproofness phase diagram for the natural inverse-nearest-neighbor power family in the minimum nontrivial n=3,k=2 setting, plus a unique best universally strategyproof exponent and exact substantially improved welfare ratio. The p=3 rule is nontrivial and not covered by the earlier n-general p=1,2 guarantees. The p>3 obstruction is sharp and holds already on the line.
